title: Reconciled
oneLiner: Invoice reconciliation platform for staffing agencies

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: Manual invoice reconciliation across VMS systems caused errors, delays, and revenue leakage for staffing agencies.

myRole.heading: Role
myRole.description: Built core frontend systems and analytics; partnered with leadership to deliver scalable, high-impact product features.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Delivered with the team a platform to automate invoice matching, detect discrepancies, and streamline reconciliation workflows.

impact.heading: Impact
impact.description: Became the flagship product driving acquisition, improving billing accuracy and accelerating delivery through system-wide refactoring.
